units.rawText: The upright discerner of truth, with the acumen of a thousand men! 'Tis I, the great sage Kuro. Not accurate? No payment!

units.rawText: At the entrance to the festival, a Doll clad in strange garments hollers as they wave about a banner.

units.rawText: This Professor here, I see that you are someone of exquisite handsomeness, an almost supernatural presence, and a strong constitution... I suspect that we may be linked by the threads of fate. I bestow this lucky charm upon you.

units.rawText: I accept the charm from her. On the piece of white paper were scribbled a series of strange-looking lines, with the only discernible symbol being Kuro's signature.
units.displayText: I accept the charm from her. On the piece of white paper were scribbled a series of strange-looking lines, with the only discernible symbol being Kuro's signature.

units.rawText: Seeing as destiny saw fit to place us together today, perhaps you could consider taking off the ban on my streaming account, as that's something that'll accumulate good karma...

units.rawText: Uhh... can you say something, Professor? When you stare at me like that... it's scary...

units.rawText: Say, seeing as you're so wise in the ways of the world and adept in the affairs of both war and peace... cough, would you maybe allow me to read a fortune of yours?

units.rawText: I'd be shocked if you got anything accurate at all with this crummy scam of yours.

units.rawText: Excuse me, who do you take me for? I'm the well renowned...

units.rawText: Hm? What are you doing here, Evelyn?
